fields.Fees — Published:
₹3,72,300 calculated two-year Dual Specialization academic total: annual tuition ₹1,64,000, exams ₹20,000 and insurance ₹650; one-time caution ₹2,000 and ID ₹1,000.

fields.Fee Scope: Calculated from published annual components plus one-time charges; hostel extra; fee revisions possible

fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree with at least 55% aggregate.
fields.Selection Process: Qualifying-degree merit, with preference for listed national management-entrance scores; programme page does not prescribe GD/PI or numerical weights.
